description: The den kit's guards, for any project that loads the den plugin: context budget, board identity and raw-jg guard, uncapped test runs, sleep chains. Every guard runs from this plugin's own folder (hooks/*.mjs, mirrored from scripts/hooks and mods/; a test fails on drift), so a by-name install works. Board identity does nothing without the den's apps/board beside the plugin; the context budget reads its token count with the den's scripts/context.mjs, which a --plugin-dir <den>/.claude load finds and a by-name install does not (it then allows). A missing guard blocks the call.

hooks.command: test -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/context-budget.mjs" || { echo "den plugin: guard script missing (context-budget.mjs); reinstall the den plugin" >&2; exit 2; }; node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/context-budget.mjs"

test -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/bash-guard.mjs" || { echo "den plugin: guard script missing (bash-guard.mjs); reinstall the den plugin" >&2; exit 2; }; node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/bash-guard.mjs"

test -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/test-run-guard.mjs" || { echo "den plugin: guard script missing (test-run-guard.mjs); reinstall the den plugin" >&2; exit 2; }; node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/test-run-guard.mjs"

test -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/sleep-guard.mjs" || { echo "den plugin: guard script missing (sleep-guard.mjs); reinstall the den plugin" >&2; exit 2; }; node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/sleep-guard.mjs"
